title: Power of Two
description:
Given an integer n, return true if it is a power of two, otherwise return false.

An integer is a power of two if there exists an integer x such that n == 2^x.

Input: a single line containing the integer n.
Output: 'true' or 'false'.

title: Fibonacci Number
description:
The Fibonacci numbers form a sequence where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones, starting from 0 and 1. That is, F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1, and F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) for n > 1.

Given n, compute F(n).

Input: a single line containing the integer n.
Output: F(n) as a single integer.

title: Isomorphic Strings
description:
Given two strings s and t, determine if they are isomorphic.

Two strings are isomorphic if the characters in s can be replaced to get t. All occurrences of a character must be replaced with another character while preserving the order of characters. No two characters may map to the same character, but a character may map to itself.

Input: line 1 is s; line 2 is t.
Output: 'true' or 'false'.

examples.explanation: o would need to map to both a and r.

constraints: s and t consist of any valid ASCII characters.

title: Find Pivot Index
description:
Given an array of integers nums, calculate the pivot index of this array.

The pivot index is the index where the sum of all the numbers strictly to the left of the index is equal to the sum of all the numbers strictly to the index's right.

If the index is on the left edge of the array, the left sum is 0 because there are no elements to the left. Return the leftmost pivot index. If no such index exists, return -1.

Input: a JSON array of integers.
Output: the pivot index, or -1.

examples.explanation: There is no index that satisfies the condition.
